description: Android Fragment class 'DocumentsFragment' responsible for displaying, searching, exporting, and merging scanned documents within the CamScanner app. Manages UI components such as RecyclerView and SearchView, and interacts with DocumentRepository and PdfExporter to perform document operations.

classes.name: DocumentsFragment
classes.description: A Fragment that displays and manages a list of documents with search, export, and merge functionalities.

methods.name: newInstance
methods.description: Creates a new instance of DocumentsFragment.

methods.name: onAttach
methods.description: Initializes the DocumentRepository when the fragment attaches to a context.

methods.name: onCreateView
methods.description: Inflates the fragment layout and sets up RecyclerView and SearchView references.

methods.name: onViewCreated
methods.description: Configures RecyclerView layout and adapter, sets up SearchView listeners, and initiates initial data load.

methods.name: addMenu
methods.description: Adds menu options for exporting and merging PDFs via MenuProvider.

methods.name: load
methods.description: Loads documents from the repository based on the search query and updates the adapter.

methods.name: exportSelected
methods.description: Exports selected documents as a combined PDF file.

methods.name: mergeSelected
methods.description: Merges selected documents into a single PDF.

methods.name: onDestroyView
methods.description: Nullifies references to clean up the view.
